title_en: Information Theory and Renormalization Group Flows

verified_metadata.title: Information Theory and Renormalization Group Flows
verified_metadata.journal: Physica A: Statistical Mechanics and its Applications
verified_metadata.abstract: Conditional entropy quantifies information discarded by a Wilsonian step, while mutual information and entropy per site provide monotonicity statements for selected real-space decimations.
verified_metadata.comment: ArXiv v4 full text cross-checked with Physica A metadata

sections.title: 作者信息
paragraphs: 作者 S. M. Apenko；Physica A 391, 62–77 (2012)，DOI:10.1016/j.physa.2011.08.014。核验 arXiv:0910.2097v4 全文13页。

sections.title: 研究问题
paragraphs: Wilsonian RG积分掉fast variables，直觉上丢失information并应不可逆。能否用Shannon entropy、conditional entropy与mutual information构造一般的RG monotone？为什么总entropy下降本身不足以排除limit cycles或复杂RG flows？

sections.title: 背景
paragraphs: 将microscopic variables分为slow η与fast ψ，joint distribution p(η,ψ)在coarse graining后变为p(η)。链式法则H(η,ψ)=H(η)+H(ψ|η)说明丢失量是非负conditional entropy。

但H是extensive，RG同时减少degrees of freedom；即使总H下降，也可能只是system size缩小而非couplings沿flow不可逆。需要考察entropy per site或size-independent subleading term。连续变量differential entropy还依赖measure/units，作者主要在lattice examples中工作。

sections.title: 模型与方法
paragraphs: 论文定义fast–slow mutual information I(η;ψ)=H(η)+H(ψ)−H(η,ψ)，计算1D Ising decimation、Gaussian model和spin-1 real-space RG。对隔点decimation，在sublattices对称时利用mutual-information positivity推导renormalized entropy density不减。
还研究triangular-lattice majority-rule/block-spin transformations，指出coarse-grained mapping若确定且多对一，conditional distributions和block correlations决定lost information；并讨论additive constant/free-energy关系。

sections.title: 核心结果与证据
paragraphs: 单步总entropy严格满足H(slow)≤H(all)，但这不是c-theorem。对于1D隔点decimation，两个sublattices有相同entropy，I≥0给h'≥h，即每剩余site的信息entropy沿RG增长；这在该变换下提供irreversibility方向。
Figure 1画1D/2D decimation partitions；Figure 2显示spin-1 model在(x,y)couplings平面上的RG flow与四个fixed points A–D、critical line AC。沿箭头entropy per site增长，并在fixed points取0、ln2、(1/2)ln2等值。
Figure 3的triangular block-spin说明更一般变换中mutual information仍可定义，但不能自动给普适monotone。文章以examples和inequalities提出信息论视角，不声称证明任意quantum/continuum RG的c/a/F theorem。

sections.title: 有效性与局限
paragraphs: 关键monotonicity只对某些real-space decimations、translation symmetry和恰当normalized entropy成立。differential entropy可为负且随coordinate scaling变，continuous fields需要relative entropy或regulator；paper没有解决scheme dependence。
entropy per site增长方向与通常central charge decrease不是同一quantity；size-independent additive term被提出为候选但未一般构造。复杂RG、gauge constraints、quantum entanglement和non-equilibrium coarse graining不在证明范围。

sections.title: 复现与资源
paragraphs: 全文：https://arxiv.org/abs/0910.2097；期刊：https://doi.org/10.1016/j.physa.2011.08.014。PDF SHA-256：4109eebe56299a24f41ac80c87af0508af767b6ac384f4fb891f4ff28a4710d3。无代码需求或仓库。

复核需固定log base、entropy normalization、block/decimation map和spin-1 coupling coordinates；可按Eqs. (12)–(35)逐步计算conditional/mutual information与fixed-point values。Evidence status: full-text verified analytical study; no independent reproduction performed.

sections.title: 阅读指南
paragraphs: 先读 pp.1–3 entropy chain rule与问题；pp.4–6看mutual information和Ising decimation；p.8 Figure 2读spin-1 RG flow；pp.9–11看block-spin examples；pp.11–13读适用边界与结论。
